title: AO/283/2017 of SMT. SUSHILA PACHHAMI Vs MUNINDRA DATT SAKLANI

paras.text:
A.O. No. 283 of 2017
Hon 'b le Man oj K. Tiw ar i, J.
Mr. Hrishek Lakhera, Advocate for the
appellant (applicant in recall application).
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for
respondent no. 1.
Mr. Rahul Consul, Advocate for
respondent no. 2.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
As per office report, there is no delay in
preferring the recall application.
This application (MCC No. 5582 of 2021)
has been filed seeking recall of the final order
dated 07.01.2021, whereby the Appeal from
Order was dismissed.
Learned counsel for the appellant
submits that there was no representation for
the appellant on 07.01.2021, consequently,
the Appeal was dismissed.
Learned counsel appearing for
respondent no. 1 submits that his client had
passed away on 10.05.2017 i.e. m uch before
filing of the Appeal when learned trial Court
was considering tem porary injunction
application filed by respondent no. 1. He
further submits that, after death of
respondent no. 1, his legal representatives
were substituted by order of learned trial
Court. Thus, he submits that this recall
application is not m aintainable and the Appeal
itself is abated due to non impleadment of
legal representatives of respondent no. 1.
Be that as it m ay, the fact rem ains that
the order dated 07.01.2021, which is sought
to be recalled, has been passed after
considering the m erits of the Appeal and no
sufficient cause has been shown to recall that
order.
Consequently, the recall application is
dismissed. However, the appellant/ applicant
shall be at liberty to m ove appropriate

application seeking expeditious disposal of the
pending suit before the learned trial Court,
which shall be considered on m erits by
learned trial Court.

( Man oj K. Tiw ar i, J.)
Arpan 22.03.2021
